names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 2 Μαρτίου, «Όσιοι Βαρσανούφιος, Σάββας, Σαββάτιος και Ευφρόσυνος εκ Ρωσίας», with the rank word and the country left off.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026). saint.gr calls the four of them «εκ Ρωσίας», so that calendar is the one most likely to hold them, and it was not read.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 2ης Μαρτίου — «Όσιοι Βαρσανούφιος, Σάββας, Σαββάτιος και Ευφρόσυνος εκ Ρωσίας»

attestations.note: The line enumerates all four by name, so each is kept as a folder of his own. The whole notice is two sentences, which give the century, the country, the district of Tver and a peaceful repose, and nothing else. The page's only image under the four is labelled «Όσιος Σαββάτιος». The corpus keeps several other men of this name, of Krypetsk, of Vishera, of Venetala, of Zographou, the Sanctified, the stratelates, and one on 27 August; none of them is on this day.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026).

floruit.note: saint.gr: «Οι Όσιοι Βαρσανούφιος, Σάββας, Σαββάτιος και Ευφρόσυνος έζησαν στη Ρωσία κατά τον 15ο αιώνα μ.Χ. και ασκήτεψαν στην περιοχή Τβερ» — the century is the page's and it gives it for all four.
